elision.label: Elision
elision.task: Ask the child to say the stimulus word with the specified sound (or, at Tier 0, word part) removed.

blending.label: Blending
blending.task: Say each part separately (brief pause between), and ask the child to blend them into one word. At Tier 0, parts can be word parts, syllables, onset + rime, or single sounds.

segmentation.label: Segmentation
segmentation.task: Say the stimulus word and ask the child to say every sound in it, one at a time (at Tier 0, some items ask for syllables or word parts instead).

isolation.label: Phoneme Isolation
isolation.task: Ask the child to identify a single sound (first / last / Nth) in the stimulus word.

nonwordEB.label: Nonword Elision-Blending
nonwordEB.task: Same elision/blending tasks as above, using invented nonwords instead of real words.

digits.label: Memory for Digits
digits.task: Read the digit string aloud at about 1 digit/second; the child repeats it back in order.

nonwordRep.label: Nonword Repetition
nonwordRep.task: Say the nonword clearly; the child repeats it back exactly.
